mentions.name: Alder Lake coreboot port
mentions.description: An effort to port coreboot to an Alder Lake motherboard, currently focused on decompiling and documenting Intel CSME 16 firmware, a slow process aided by AI models (Opus 4.8, limited by provider guard rails).
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on something similar for an Alder Lake motherboard to try to get coreboot ported. Right now I’m working through decompiling and documenting CSME 16 and it’s a slog with guard rails limiting me to Opus 4.8.
